items.description:
Yemen’s Houthis have launched a major ground assault around the Bab al-Mandab Strait, the Red Sea chokepoint that has become vital for Saudi oil exports during the Middle East war.
With hundreds dead in fighting, and the Houthis exchanging strikes and counter-strikes with Saudi Arabia, AFP examines the flashpoint waterway that is normally one of the world’s busiest shipping lanes.

items.title: HRCP condemns decision to rusticate Afghan students
items.description:
LAHORE: The Human Rights Commission of Pakistan (HRCP) on Wednesday condemned the decision to rusticate and repatriate Afghan students already enrolled in medical and dental colleges in Pakistan, warning that the move could turn an education policy into a humanitarian crisis.
The rights body said the decision, along with the reported bar on new admissions for Afghan students, had put the education, safety and future of young Afghans at immediate risk.

items.title: Polio workers to get 28pc stipend raise
items.description:
ISLAMABAD: The Pakistan Polio Eradication Initiative (PEI) on Wednesday announced a 28 per cent increase in the daily stipend for over 400,000 campaign-based frontline workers ahead of the next sub-national campaign, scheduled for Sept 21-27.
During the upcoming drive, vaccination teams will reach more than 31 million children across 115 districts in Baloch­istan, Gilgit-Baltistan, Isl­­amab­­ad, Khyber Pakh­tunkhwa, Punjab and Sindh.

items.title: Islamabad extends rare greeting to Pyongyang
items.description:
ISLAMABAD: Pakistan on Wed­nesday made an unusual public diplomatic gesture towards North Korea, with President Asif Ali Zardari and the Foreign Office extending greetings to Pyongyang on the 78th anniversary of the country’s founding.
In a letter to DPRK President Kim Jong Un on the 78th founding anniversary of the republic, President Zardari referred to the two countries’ “cordial relations based on mutual trust and goodwill” and expressed the hope that bilateral ties would continue to grow in the interests of both countries.
